content.title: Here’s where to watch Detroit Tigers games on TV this season
content.text: DETROIT, Mich. (WILX) - As the Major League Baseball season gets underway, the Detroit Tigers have a new TV home — the brand new Detroit SportsNet.The Tigers begin the season Thursday at San Diego before Opening Day at Comerica Park on Friday, April 3 against the St. Louis Cardinals.And fans now know exactly what channel they’ll be able to watch the Tigers on. The Tigers officially confirmed distribution agreements with major cable and satellite providers across Michigan on Thursday morning.Comcast/Xfinity customers can find Detroit SportsNet on channel 1253, AT&T U-Verse customers will find DSN on channel 1739 and DirecTV customers will find it on channel 663-3 or DirecTV Stream 663. Charter/Spectrum customers will find DSN on different channels, depending on location, according to Tigers sideline reporter Daniella Bruce:Channel 213 - Lansing, Grand Rapids-Kalamazoo, Detroit, Alpena, Duluth-Superior, Flint-Saginaw, Marquette, Traverse CityChannel 291 - LivoniaChannel 307/1307 - Ft. Wayne, Green Bay-Appleton, ToledoChannel 436 - If watching on the Spectrum AppFubo is the only streaming service listed on the Tigers website. That means YouTube TV users will not be able to watch the Tigers on Detroit SportsNet.But DSN is offering a streaming app where fans can watch games in market.
